Iranian Islamic Republic Day ( Persian : روز جمهوری اسلامی ایران , romanized : ruz Jomhuri Eslām Iran ) is the national day [ 1 ] and a public holiday in Iran . [ 2 ] [ 3 ] [ 4 ] [ 5 ] It marks the day that the results of the 1979 Iranian Islamic Republic referendum were announced.  The results announced were a 98.2% vote for the establishment of an Islamic republic in Iran.
